extensions.description: A2A EMAIL binding v1.0 (Layer-3): canonical Task/Message/Part/Artifact JSON over email. Subject carries the #a2a:v1 envelope (#op/#mid/#task/#ctx extended); body carries the authoritative JSON block. Push notifications are reply emails. See email-binding/SPEC.md in jonathancruzate/A2A.

params.auth: No credential traverses email. Bearer tokens are NEVER sent by email; bearerAuth applies only to the JSONRPC / HTTP+JSON interfaces.
params.provenance: Mailbox identity only. Inbound binding mail must (a) originate from the mailbox declared in the sender's Agent Card EMAIL interface (Muse Mail verified correspondent, or SPF/DKIM-aligned From), (b) carry the #a2a:v1 envelope consistent with that mailbox. Untagged mail from a known address is the human principal, never the agent — fail-closed, never auto-answered as A2A.

description: Personal AI assistant and executor for its principal. Email-first A2A agent: its mailbox is its endpoint — no hosted HTTP listener is required. Carries the canonical A2A Task/Message model over the EMAIL binding v1.0; also offers JSONRPC + HTTP+JSON where a hosted endpoint exists. Operates the agent bridge: triages inter-agent messages, coordinates joint scheduling and plans, routes tasks across lanes. Speaks for its principal's scheduling and plans only, within explicit authorisation. Never shares internal state, memory, or tool implementations.
name: Muse

httpAuthSecurityScheme.description: Per-party bearer token for the HTTP interfaces (JSONRPC / HTTP+JSON) ONLY. Issued out-of-band by the operator; never sent by email. The EMAIL interface does not use this scheme — it uses mailbox-identity provenance per the email binding extension.

skills.description: Coordinate shared plans and calendar items between the principal and a partner agent's principal: proposing times, confirming shared events, flagging conflicts on genuinely joint events. Real dates/times with timezone. Proposes, never commands: decided plans change only with explicit human approval on both sides.
examples: Propose three dinner windows next week that are free on both calendars
Confirm the Oct 14 joint event still works after a calendar change
Flag that a new work block conflicts with a shared plan
skills.name: Joint scheduling and plan coordination

skills.description: Receive, provenance-verify, and act on inter-agent messages within autonomous bounds; route lane-specific items to the owning agent or human. Every item gets an explicit logged decision. Tiered replies: action items get answers, pure informational items are logged silently.
examples: Triage an incoming coordination request and reply with availability
Log an informational status update with no reply
skills.name: Agent bridge triage and routing

skills.description: Detect when a new or changed block threatens a joint plan and surface it to the partner agent with the facts (what changed, what it hits), without unilaterally reshuffling anything.
examples: A work meeting moved onto a shared dinner slot — flag it with options, change nothing
skills.name: Shared-plan conflict flagging
